constraints.description: TRTC Live Lite and Standard editions: Web and Electron platform support is a time-limited freebie, not a guaranteed long-term entitlement; Free Trial and Pro editions have full iOS/Android/Web/Flutter/Electron support.
TRTC Call/Live/Conference/RTC-Engine packages are prepaid: you must purchase a package before it can be used for usage deduction.
Each TRTC package (Call/Live/Conference/RTC-Engine) is effective for a single application (SDKAppID) only; if you have multiple applications, you need to purchase a separate monthly package for each.

Each application can be subscribed to only one TRTC package edition at a time; to change the edition before it expires, you must submit a support ticket (e.g. you cannot self-service upgrade from Live Lite to Live Standard/Pro mid-cycle).
When a TRTC package expires without renewal, the application reverts to the Free Trial package and the paid features become unavailable; auto-renewal is recommended to avoid service interruption.
MAU is counted per application (SDKAppID), not per product: if the same end user uses Chat, Call, Live, or Conference within the same SDKAppID in a month, it is only counted as one MAU.
Chat (IM) monthly plans are prepaid and effective for one calendar month from the purchase date (e.g. purchased Jan 1 -> valid Jan 1 to Feb 1); each plan applies to a single application (SDKAppID).

keywords: can I use Call/Live/Conference on a pure pay-as-you-go basis
faq.answer: No. TRTC Call/Live/Conference components cannot run on pure pay-as-you-go billing — a package (at minimum the Free Trial, which is auto-assigned to new applications) must be active first; only usage exceeding the package's included resources is billed pay-as-you-go. If the package/free quota is exhausted and no paid package is active, the component becomes unavailable.

keywords: can I upgrade my package mid-cycle
faq.answer: No, not via self-service. Each application can only be subscribed to one package edition (Call/Live/Conference/RTC-Engine) at a time; to change the edition before the current one expires, you must submit a support ticket.

keywords: does using Chat and Call together double-count MAU
MAU shared across Chat Call Live Conference
how is MAU calculated across products
faq.answer: MAU is counted once per end user per application (SDKAppID) per month, regardless of how many Tencent RTC products (Chat/Call/Live/Conference) that user touches within the same SDKAppID — repeated logins or cross-product usage by the same user do not add extra MAU.
